removedComponent: GNU libc is absent, including its loader and compatibility shims; its 22 distinct findings no longer describe shipped code.

alignedAllocation.disposition: POSIX allocation path; upstream says modern posix_memalign targets are unaffected
alignedAllocation.evidence: Build regression rejects near-SIZE_MAX allocations and checks normal alignment. Its libstdc++ bytes must match the runtime root.
